title: NEXDOT Management
subtitle: Manage the shop storefront: homepage CMS, footer, and Resources downloads.
readOnlyHint: You can view this page. Only group admins and system admins can add, edit, or delete banners, featured products, and footer settings.

resources.imagesHint: ZIP archives of product imagery for dealers to download. Only .zip files are accepted.
resources.documentsHint: Spec sheets and catalogs as PDF. Only .pdf files are accepted.
resources.blogHint: Upload Markdown (.md) files. Title and slug are editable after upload.
resources.deleteImageConfirm: Delete this image pack? The ZIP will be removed from storage.
resources.deleteDocConfirm: Delete this document? The PDF will be removed from storage.
resources.deleteBlogConfirm: Delete this blog post? This cannot be undone.

sectionBannersHint: Hero carousel slides shown on the shop homepage, in this order.
sectionFeaturedHint: {{count}} / {{max}} products shown on the shop homepage, in this order.
deleteBannerConfirm: Remove this image from the homepage carousel? This cannot be undone.
deleteFeaturedConfirm: Remove "{{name}}" from the featured products list?
sectionStoriesHint: {{count}} / {{max}} story cards on the shop homepage. Order 1 is the large left tile; 2–7 fill the right grid (top to bottom, then next column).
deleteStoryConfirm: Remove this story card from the homepage? This cannot be undone.
sectionFooterHint: Address, email, and phone shown in the shop site footer. Use Edit / Save to update.
footerSocialHint: Drag to change Follow-us icon order. Toggle Active/Inactive and edit each URL independently; changes save immediately.
